name: Firestorm Assault Force
description: All ranged weapons gain Assault and +1 Strength within 12".

name: Ironstorm Spearhead
description: Armoured Wrath: Once per phase for each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Wrath of The Doomed
description: Fanatical Celerity: When a friendly Death Company unit is selected to make an Advance move, it suffers D3+1 mortal wounds but remains eligible to declare a charge. This detachment has the DOOMED tag and cannot be taken with another DOOMED detachment.
